title: starkdt
tagline: display detailed StarkNet account information and bubble maps of the coins held.

prizes.placement: Pool for projects which use Dynamic
prizes.title: Pool for projects which use Dynamic

description: StarkDT is a sophisticated web application developed using Next.js, specifically designed to target the StarkNet blockchain. This application seamlessly connects to a user's cryptocurrency wallet, providing a comprehensive display of detailed account information. Additionally, StarkDT features interactive bubble maps that visually represent the coins held within the user's wallet, enhancing the user's ability to understand and manage their digital assets.
how_its_made: The application is built using the Dynamic Labs SDK, enabling seamless wallet interaction and integration. It leverages the Voyager API to fetch real-time blockchain data, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information for the users. StarkDT operates on the StarkNet Sepolia test network, providing a secure and reliable environment for development and testing.
